DOCUMENT CHECKLIST

COME PREPARED.

The published admission guide lists the following documents. Confirm the current checklist with the admissions office.

  • SEE / SLC certificate or equivalent · two copies
  • Citizenship certificate · two copies
  • Recent passport-size photographs · four
  • Domicile certificate or passport for foreign students · two copies

ADMISSION QUESTIONS

USEFUL THINGS TO KNOW.

How do I start?

Explore the programs and contact BIT administration for the current application form and intake details.

Is there a CTEVT entrance requirement?

Follow the applicable CTEVT entrance and eligibility requirements. Ask BIT for the current notice and dates.

What are the fees and available seats?

Contact the admissions office for current program fees, application fees and seat availability.

Can I ask about a scholarship?

Yes. BIT publishes information about CTEVT classified or special schemes and internal merit scholarships. Ask about current eligibility and availability.
